meta_and_positioning.design_persona: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer (Premium Botanical B2B)
meta_and_positioning.positioning_statement: FloraSetu is an elegant, authoritative, and trustworthy B2B floriculture procurement and fulfilment network. The design bridges physical botanical craft with modern digital infrastructure using rich botanical greens, orchid plum accents, warm ivory surfaces, and bespoke serif typography.
meta_and_positioning.emotional_tone: Refined, calm, authoritative, precise, and botanically grounded.
meta_and_positioning.design_context: B2B Marketing Landing Page & Public Identity System with React SPA frontend using vanilla CSS tokens, high-density operational contrast, and exact brand SVG geometry.
meta_and_positioning.dark_mode_stance: Light Theme Default with warm botanical ivory (#F8F8F5), deep forest emerald (#183D33), and plum (#76518F / #5C3A4D). Dark green contrast bands and footers create structural rhythm.

logo_geometry.left_green_petal: M32 34 C27 32 20 28 17 20 C25 21 31 27 32 34 Z (fill: deep botanical green #183D33)
logo_geometry.right_green_petal: M32 34 C37 32 44 28 47 20 C39 21 33 27 32 34 Z (fill: deep botanical green #183D33)
logo_geometry.detached_bottom_arc: M8 52 A28 18 0 0 1 56 52 (stroke: deep botanical green #183D33, strokeWidth: 6, strokeLinecap: round, fill: none)
logo_geometry.relative_positioning_rule: The 3 petals sit OVER the detached arc; petal junctions terminate at y=34 above the arc, creating clean visual separation with no overlapping or crossing line segments.

wordmark_typography.flora_styling: Flora in deep botanical green (#183D33), serif, 600 weight
wordmark_typography.size_ratio: Elegant high-contrast display serif wordmark matching reference design

color_system.contrast_policy: All public text and interactive buttons meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text, 3:1 for large display headers).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure PublicHomePage uses the elegant white lilies hero photo specified.
Ensure Logo.tsx renders the exact 3-petal + detached arc geometry with plum central petal and green side petals/arc.
Maintain all data-testid attributes for automated testing compatibility.
Ensure two-tone serif wordmark is styled with 'Flora' in deep botanical green and 'Setu' in plum.
No external dependencies or unvetted libraries needed; pure CSS tokens + SVG geometry in React.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 2-3x generous spacing across cards and layout containers to avoid cramped UI.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Every interactive button, input, link, tab, and card MUST include data-testid='kebab-case-id'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.theme: Use light mode warm ivory (#F8F8F5) with deep botanical green (#183D33) and plum (#76518F).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Fraunces / Cormorant Garamond for display headlines & wordmark; Inter for body text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.components: Reuse pre-existing components in src/components/ and design tokens.
